🎓 A SELECT COMMITTEE CALLED IT MIS-SELLING

The Treasury Committee concluded that the way student loans were presented to teenagers by the DfE and Student Loans Company amounted to mis-selling. More than 52,000 people responded to its survey — one of the biggest responses any committee inquiry has had.

The government's answer? Redesign the guidance for future students. The frozen repayment threshold — the stealth tax already hitting graduates every month — stays "under review". 😤
